Example: How Tall is The Tree?Start with:sin(45°)=OppositeHypotenuseWe know:0.7071...=Opposite20Swap sides:Opposite20=0.7071...Multiply both sides by20:Opposite=0.7071... × 20Calculate:Opposite=14.14(to 2 decimals)The tree is 14.14m tall
Example: what is the cosine of 370°?370° is greater than 360° so let us subtract 360°370° − 360°=10°cos(370°)=cos(10°)=0.985(to 3 decimal places)
Example: what is the sine of −3 radians?−3 is less than 0so let us add 2πradians−3 + 2π=−3 + 6.283...=3.283... radianssin(−3)=sin(3.283...)=−0.141(to 3 decimal places)
